# REQ: LANG-2921 LANG-2922 LANG-2923 LANG-2924
# Ensure a file exists
bundle agent demo
{
  vars:
      "greeting" string => "Hello";
  files:
      "/tmp/hello.txt"
        create => "true",
        edit_line => insert_lines("$(greeting), world");
  reports:
    linux::
      "Done: ${greeting}";
}
